summary: T Stamp Inc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity distribution agreement dated October 9, 2026 with Maxim Group LLC, permitting sales of common stock up to $5,323,474. Maxim earns up to 3.0% commission on gross proceeds; no escrow or trust arrangement. Shares sold on a commercially reasonable efforts basis, with Maxim potentially deemed an underwriter. Nasdaq trading under IDAI; last sale $3.39 on October 8, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and any acceleration in share sales under the program.
